displayName: Uniqlo API - Prices by Country, Stock by Size, Reviews
description: Uniqlo API for Uniqlo prices by country, Japan vs the rest - one uniqlo.com product id (E479000-000) priced in up to 10 markets per call, each in its own currency (never converted), with promo price, limited-offer and sale flags (Uniqlo's own offer labels), and tax inclusive or exclusive; product ids are the same in every uniqlo.com market. Online stock by colour and size, stock per store near a point, customer reviews with fit feedback (1 tight to 5 loose), purchased size and height, weight and age ranges, keyword search, product detail with composition and country of origin, category lists, the sale and limited-offer lists, new arrivals, the category tree, stores with opening hours and search suggestions. Every endpoint on the US, Japan and South Korea; search and product on Taiwan, Hong Kong and China (their own product codes); product and prices on 35 more storefronts (UK, Canada, Australia, India, Southeast Asia, the EU markets). 12 endpoints, 1 credit per call (store stock by product, colour and size 2; prices 1 per market). No price history (poll and store).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
